name: Species, Subspecies, and Upbringing Inheritance
description: Species and Subspecies represent inherited traits; Upbringings represent learned traditions. Their parentage is independent, and biological ancestry does not by itself restrict Upbringing selection.

speciesInheritance.selection: Selecting a terminal Subspecies resolves its ancestor chain without requiring the user to select each ancestor.
speciesInheritance.filesystem: Directories may mirror the hierarchy but stable parent IDs are authoritative.

defaultSelectionOrder: Use an explicitly selected Upbringing instead of an ancestry default.
Otherwise use the selected Subspecies defaultUpbringing, when present.
Otherwise traverse the selected Subspecies parent chain to the nearest ancestor with defaultUpbringing.
If no default exists, leave selection unresolved instead of inventing an Upbringing.
upbringings.inheritance: The selected Upbringing inherits the benefits of its own parent chain; ancestors are not additional selections.
upbringings.association: A default is a reference on Species/Subspecies JSON, not a reverse defaultFor list on Upbringing records.

reviewNotes: Both Chromatic and Metallic family records and all ten leaf types have selected native content; Gem leaves remain deferred.
Only ten standard Chromatic and Metallic Dragonborn are in the active first pass; Gem is reserved structurally.
Half-Elf and Half-Orc are reserved for the future Mixed Species mechanic, not initial Species.
The native C# character projector does not yet execute ancestry inheritance/default selections.
